description: "Records a tractor and driver passing the gate and the trailers they bring. DirectOnCheckIn creates, per trailer, a move created already CLAIMED by the VISITING_DRIVER (no lease): to the appointment door when it is free, open and flow-compatible, otherwise to the first free spot of the site's parking zones, and a walk-in or an arrival earlier than the appointment tolerance goes to a holding spot (TO_HOLDING). <MethodEndpoint

Records a tractor and driver passing the gate and the trailers they bring. DirectOnCheckIn creates, per trailer, a move created already CLAIMED by the VISITING_DRIVER (no lease): to the appointment door when it is free, open and flow-compatible, otherwise to the first free spot of the site's parking zones, and a walk-in or an arrival earlier than the appointment tolerance goes to a holding spot (TO_HOLDING). SealCheckAtGate compares each recorded seal with the appointment's expected seal; a mismatch raises SealExceptionRaised and, under the REJECT policy, records a REJECTED visit instead (reason SEAL_MISMATCH). A refused check-in persists nothing: 409 `appointment-required`, `visit-already-open`, `trailer-already-on-site`, `door-closed`, `door-flow-mismatch`, `no-free-spot`, `seal-class-too-low` (the site yard policy sets `minimumSealClass` and the seal is of a lower class or has none); 422 `invalid-carrier`, `unknown-appointment` (also when the visit names an appointment but does not carry exactly one trailer), `invalid-unit-number`, `invalid-seal-class`, `validation`. The unit number of a `CONTAINER` trailer, and of any trailer whose `unitNumberScheme` is `ISO6346`, must be an ISO 6346 container number (4 letters: a 3-letter owner code and the category U, J or Z; 6 digits; the check digit), else 422 `invalid-unit-number` whose detail names the expected check digit; a domestic road trailer keeps a free-form number. A matching seal ends `VERIFIED` and a different one `MISMATCH` (ADR 0012). The gate clerk may then record the refusal with `POST /visit-rejections`.
